title: Musculoskeletal pain syndrome in the head and shoulder region in professional Singers using digital musical scores
summary: The study aims to compare the pain load while singing with a tablet and while singing with conventional paper music scores. To accomplish this, professional singers are surveyed on musculoskeletal pain and their body posture while singing is measured.

interventions.name: The observation group consists of professional singers who use digital and conventional (paper) sheet music in their concerts and rehearsals. To this end, a survey using standardised questionnaires (Quick DASH with musician module, CMDQ, NDI, VDI) will be conducted at three different times of stress
